description: Erection of a rear roof extension with two front roof windows to the flat
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( First floor proposed (received on 24 December 2019) and; Site location plan; elevations existing (received on 06 January 2020); and loft floor proposed; roof proposed; elevations and sections proposed and elevations proposed (received on 21 February 2020). ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
